faqs.q: How do I book a session?
faqs.a: Reach out via the contact form or email, share your vision and preferred dates, and I will send a tailored proposal within 48 hours.

faqs.q: What is included in a shoot?
faqs.a: Pre-shoot planning, the session itself, professional retouching and a private online gallery with high-resolution downloads.

faqs.q: How long until I get my photos?
faqs.a: Edited galleries are delivered within 7 to 14 days depending on the scope of the project.
